text.autoconfig.pathweaver.title: PathWeaver
text.autoconfig.pathweaver.option.allowM: Also speed up mobs added by mods
text.autoconfig.pathweaver.option.maxInF: Maximum searches queued or running at once
text.autoconfig.pathweaver.option.repath: Reuse a valid path if the target moved less than (blocks)
text.autoconfig.pathweaver.option.stalen: Discard results after the mob moves (blocks)
text.autoconfig.pathweaver.option.enable: Master switch. Off returns pathfinding to vanilla at once: no new off-thread searches, no repath reuse.
Searches already accepted finish normally. Safe to toggle at any time.
text.autoconfig.pathweaver.option.compat: Which mods may have modified pathfinding while PathWeaver still runs searches off-thread.
About other mods' code, not about mobs. If the tier refuses your pack, nothing runs off-thread at all.
Strict: structural proofs only. Denies any pack containing Fabric API, so it usually does nothing.
Audited: also trusts bytecode audits and a bounded call-sample. Works on most packs.
Everything: no checks; runs uninspected mod code on workers. Back up your world. Restart to apply.
text.autoconfig.pathweaver.option.allowM: A different question from Compatibility risk: that one is whose code, this one is whose mob.
Off: a mob whose class comes from a mod never paths off-thread. Measured as zero, not merely fewer.
On: those mobs are treated like vanilla ones, running navigation code nobody has inspected.
'Everything' already includes this, so it only changes anything at Strict or Audited.
text.autoconfig.pathweaver.option.poolTh: Measured at 2, 4 and 16 with no consistent effect; the in-flight limit matters far more. Restart to apply.
text.autoconfig.pathweaver.option.maxInF: An admission limit, not a buffer. Raising it does not help.
A deeper queue makes each result land later, and one arriving after its mob asked again is discarded.
Measured on a 371-mod pack: 1024 left 91% of finished searches unused, 4096 effectively all of them.
Lowering wastes less but pushes searches onto the main thread. 256 measured best. Restart to apply.
text.autoconfig.pathweaver.option.repath: 0 disables path reuse entirely, which is the shipped default.
Above 0, a mob whose target drifted less than this keeps its current path instead of searching again.
text.autoconfig.pathweaver.option.stalen: Do not set this near zero. A finished search is discarded if its mob moved farther than this.
A moving mob always moves: measured at 0, 91.8% of completed searches became unusable.
The mod then does essentially nothing while appearing to work. 4 is the default and is fine.
text.autoconfig.pathweaver.option.maxRes: Leave at default. How long a finished search stays usable after it completes.
Measured at 10 and 200 ticks with no difference outside noise.
text.autoconfig.pathweaver.option.repath: Avoids searches rather than moving them off-thread. Measured at 0, 1 and 4 with no difference outside noise.
